meta.title: Taskboard permissions
meta.description: The taskboard's agent-side permission surface, as its own plugin row. It provides two entries: the left-sidebar "Tools permission" page (the tool inventory, the tool group graph editor, and template authorization) and the permission box on the composer tool row (agent tool tiers and the two-axis permission panel). This row carries an activation gate: its host half injects the agent guard service, so when the guard row is disabled this row never activates and the permission entries do not appear — that is by design, not a malfunction. Turn it off and the tools-permission page, the composer permission box, and template authorization all vanish; the taskboard's cards, state machine, board, and tech tree are unaffected. The "allow claiming cards" axis does not live here — it belongs to the taskboard toolbar in the general UI row.
